messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: metering.delta_spike detected in prod (region: us-west). token_count delta +11.6% vs 24h baseline. severity: P2. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-drift

erin: seeing the alert, looking at emitter partitions now. any customer-facing flags?

max: quick check: retention-window job backlog shows ~18k pending events since 01:10 UTC. could cause delayed windowing +double-count when processed.

jia: running a narrow query to confirm duplication keys for user buckets. query: ```SELECT count(*) as cnt, event_id, customer_id FROM metering.events WHERE ts > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY event_id, customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 50;```

erin: result: duplicates present but mostly on emitter-host-7. steps: pausing emitter host replication to stop replays. pausing via: `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-7 --replicas=0 -n prod`

max: good. also noticed prefix-KV cache TTL set to 0 on a recent deploy which might have caused re-emit on cache-miss. opened PR revert: https://git.local/r/repo/pull/421

billing-eng: heads-up — preliminary impact: ~120 customers saw transient overage flags in billing-preview (not yet invoiced). We'll suppress alerts for windows 01:00–02:30 while we reconcile. recommend manual hold on auto-charge for affected invoices.

sam-cs: contacting top 5 affected customers now with an explanation and ETA for reconciliation (target recon by EOD).

jia: after pausing emitter-7, duplicates drop to near zero in the next 7m. patch: re-enable emitter with fixed TTL and run a backfill dedupe job: `python tools/dedupe_backfill.py --from 2024-01-10T01:00Z --to 2024-01-10T03:00Z --dry-run`

erin: putting a temporary mitigations note in the incident tracker and handing off to billing+cs for customer comms. oncall to follow up for 4 hours and confirm shadow ledger matches canonical.

oncall-bot: Handoff: @max (on-call) now owning follow-up. Next check-in in 30m. :spiral_calendar_pad:
